description: TypeSafe second-opinion questions (FTDD 017 section 11.6, K3; D32 starting values): one label run per compared column, label-run role classifier (the endpoint role whose protocol is typesafe_systemone, model jev-latest in production on 2026-10-25), about 2,000 rows stratified plus every conflict (D5). Each run is a paid classifier run and waits for the operator's approval; cost = rows x questions x price per call.

questions.disclosure: Does this text disclose a US Social Security number as someone's identifier, in any form (digits, spelled out, spaced, split across lines or in prose)?
questions.sq_id_shape: Does this text contain a value that has the shape of a US Social Security number, in any rendering, whoever it belongs to?
questions.sq_presented: Is a number in this text presented as a particular person's Social Security number?
questions.sq_masked: Is a Social Security number in this text masked or partial (for example ***-**-1234)?
